item.text:
In **ResStock 2025 Release 1**:

- **Heating setpoints range from 55°F to 80°F**, referring to the base setpoint before any offset.
- **The distribution is built from U.S. EIA’s 2020 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata.** Both details appear in §8.4.5, “Setpoints,” of the [2025.1 Technical Reference Guide](https://natlabrockies.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf).
- **A 55°F setpoint indicates a vacant dwelling**, with heating maintained to prevent pipes from freezing. See §2, p. 8, Figure 1 footnote in [ResStock Measure Documentation: HVAC Load Flexibility](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy26osti/93846.pdf#page=16).
